name: Brass Dragonborn

traits.name: Sand Burrower
traits.description: You have a Burrow Speed of 15 feet through loose natural sand only. You can not burrow through stone, compact soil, built structures or water with this trait, and you leave no permanent traversable tunnel. The trait does not independently negate suffocation, visibility or other terrain restrictions.

reviewNotes: Inherits shared Dragonborn and nonselectable Metallic family traits via explicit stable parent IDs.
No cultural Upbringing default is selected until independent Dragonborn Upbringing reconciliation.
